import json

# Rules inferred from the given data (Proto-Chamic -> Phan Rang Cham):
# 1. Initial voiced stop devoices: d->t, b->p, j->c.
#    (dikiʔ->takiʔ, dilah->talàh, paday->patày)
# 2. Pretonic/first-syllable vowels i, ə -> a before a following stop
#    (dikiʔ->takiʔ, bəsey->pathey).
# 3. Final -a becomes -ɨ only after a nasal or l (lima->limɨ, lanah->linɨh);
#    after a stop it stays -a (mata->mɨta, basah->pathah, rataːk->rataʔ).
# 4. The grave accent appears only when a voiced stop is followed by a
#    voiced sonorant or voiced stop (bara->pirà, paday->patày), not before a
#    voiceless stop (dikiʔ->takiʔ).

def derive(proto):
    # proto = "dəpa"

    c1, v1, c2, v2 = proto[0], proto[1], proto[2], proto[3]
    # rule 1
    c1_out = {"d": "t", "b": "p", "j": "c"}.get(c1, c1)
    # rule 2
    v1_out = "a" if v1 in ("ə", "i") else v1
    # c2 is p, a voiceless stop, so it stays and no grave accent is added (rule 4)
    c2_out = c2
    # rule 3: after a voiceless stop the final a stays
    v2_out = "ɨ" if c2 in "mnl" else v2
    return c1_out + v1_out + c2_out + v2_out

}, ensure_ascii=False))
